items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yes, there was Carl White -- he played the banjo and he sang. Leroy Tibbs played the tenor saxophone. Clarence Cummings, he played the violin, and Willie Lynch, he played drums.

ctx.x: He played piano, I mean played guitar and sang. Clarence Cummings, he played the violin. Leroy Tibbs played tenor and Willie -- gee, I forgot his name.
